input: Owner: Weiser myths-and-legends style podcasts of Catholic and Orthodox saints, angels, patriarchs; some fiction with disclaimer, not contradicting doctrine; lighthearted bedtime; 30min-1hr; ongoing; create audio and publish; report blockers.
errors: A shell wait loop exited 1 because it cat'ed audio/manifest.json before the renderer wrote it; the render itself was fine.

run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes timed out most validate steps (300 s budget) while three Kokoro renders held the CPU; the real findings (ink.mjs header.hero contrast, siblings.mjs orphan) were rerun directly and fixed.

doc_friction.issue: It only resolves gitops/prod/front-door-tools/ and refuses when conflicts are in gitops/prod/front-door/ (the ones a new venture actually causes), so the merge was resolved by hand: take main's copy, then regen.mjs.

A compound selector like header.hero is not recognised as a background box, so a light link on a dark header reads as 1.46:1; switching to .hero passes. Not documented in PRODUCTION_PLAYBOOK or the error message.

regen.mjs does not rewrite 00-mirror-alias.conf or the portfolio-front.yaml shard mount; a new venture also needs front-door-tools.mjs --write, and that writes an uncommitted gitops/prod/front-door-tools/ scratch dir that must be deleted by hand.

deviations.why: Open PR #8683 (hearth-and-horizon) has a short kids' saints shelf. Built a separate venture rather than extending it: the owner asked for a 30-60 minute show for a different audience and directory category, and #8683 was being edited live by another session. Cross-link once both are on main.

notes: Three episodes (53, 41, 45 min) written to a new series bible, rendered offline with Kokoro, served with an RSS feed. Two episodes drafted by subagents and reviewed for doctrine and sources. Weekly scheduled session created to add an episode per week. Owner steps: public email in podcast.json and directory submissions. Full report and verification log: docs/reports/2026-10-20-saints-by-candlelight.md. Main was merged in three times (hearth-and-horizon landed mid-run); each time the front-door mirror, alias map, shard mount and tree counts were regenerated rather than hand-merged.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
